2026_03_ARI_SF.headline: Arizona tries to steady Brissett against Purdy and San Francisco’s fast-starting attack
2026_03_ARI_SF.paragraph1: Arizona heads to Santa Clara needing a cleaner offensive response after Seattle held the Cardinals to seven points, with Jacoby Brissett tasked with keeping the offense on schedule and creating chances for Marvin Harrison Jr. San Francisco arrives 2-0 behind an exceptionally efficient start from Brock Purdy, while Kyle Shanahan can keep stressing Arizona horizontally and underneath with Christian McCaffrey. The Cardinals’ clearest counter is avoiding negative early-down plays and keeping San Francisco’s pass rush from controlling long-yardage snaps.
2026_03_ARI_SF.model_rationale: Arizona needs sustained early-down efficiency to keep manageable down-and-distance, while San Francisco can lean on Purdy’s rhythm and McCaffrey’s versatility to control the matchup.
